remaining_findings.detail: timed_state and timed_run check remaining() before returning the response to the attempt accumulator. The 181-second synthetic successful state is correctly rejected, but failed_attempts retains only the start time, losing the observed response. Retain an outcome with argv/timeout/timing and its response before the post-I/O deadline assertion, without accepting the late result.
remaining_findings.title: A successful over-deadline I/O observation is discarded

remaining_findings.detail: The exception serializer decodes byte stdout/stderr with errors=replace. Exact synthetic bytes ff657861637400 and fe657272 become replacement characters; the original bytes cannot be reconstructed from the retained JSON or outer SSH output. Add lossless base64 plus byte length/SHA for byte outcomes; keep readable text as a convenience only.
remaining_findings.title: Timeout byte custody is lossy
